violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Staff will wash, rinse, and sanitize the slicer. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Potato salad, macaroni salad, and lo mein, which were prepared in advance, were not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Staff voluntarily disposed of the food items during this inspection. -Establishment must keep a daily cooling log for all foods in the cooling process. -Cooling logs must be completed and provided to inspector upon the next re-inspection date. -Cooling logs provided to establishment at the time of this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Spinach pies and spinach-pepperoni pies were observed held at (116-122) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. -Per interview of staff, pies were prepared less than 2 hours prior to this inspection. -Staff reheated the spinach pies and spinach-pepperoni pies to 165 degrees Fahrenheit for hot holding during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Swiss and mozzarella scones (prepared from scratch with cheese and eggs) were observed held at (81) degrees Fahrenheit on the front counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. -Per interview of staff, swiss and mozzarella scones were stored on the counter more than 4 hours prior to this inspection. -Staff voluntarily disposed of the scones during this inspection. -Proper cold holding temperatures for TCS foods reviewed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Staff washed, rinsed, and sanitized the can opener during this inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Spinach pie and 3 cheese scones observed at 100-102 degrees during this inspection. Staff opted to voluntarily dispose of the spinach pie and cheese scones during this inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Prepared foods was observed held at 43-56 degrees Fahrenheit in the front display case. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. -Staff voluntarily disposed of the TCS foods during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Several TCS foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
ROP hot chili oil not approved by RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Placed under embargo during this inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Pasta salad, potato salad, and lasagna observed covered with plastic wrap at 46-65 degrees Fahrenheit and cooling in the 2 door reach-in refrigerator. -Proper cooling methods reviewed. -As TCS foods were prepared earlier today, TCS foods were moved to the freezer to rapidly cool during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Pastries, packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

The front Prepared Foods display case was not in good repair. Ambient observed 40-55 degrees Fahrenheit. Establishment shall not store TCS foods in the display case until it can consistently maintain an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit throughout unit. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent buildup of residue. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the retail refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2024

The ceiling in the kitchen area above the prep table is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. The appropriate tiles are on site. Tiles to be moved over to prep area. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2024

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the single door reach-in and lowboy have an accumulation of bio-film. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the back storag area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024
Holes were observed in the wall underneath the 3-bay sink and in the back storage area. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024
Rodent droppings were observed in both back storage areas. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024
The ceiling in the prep area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2024
